text: つぎのページ　あけちゃおうか？

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is the casual form of てしまう; here it means going ahead and doing it. おう means 'let's'. あけちゃおうか = 'shall we just open it?'

patterns.name: 〜ましょう
patterns.explanation: おう form with か offers or suggests doing something together. あけちゃおうか？ = 'Shall we open it?'
